name: The Truth and Faking It
source:
A Gobblepot fangame in Gotham TV universe.

Oswald visits a new bar where he runs into Jim.  But of course he's not there to party - it's a case. Oswald decides to help him out, and from then on it's in your hands. Will they find the criminal? Will they grow closer or remain as they were? What about a seaside vacation?

Play and find out!

Features:
~16000 words
A somewhat detective plot
Flirting
A bit of comedy
Bad, Neutral, Good and Perfect variants of endings depending on how many points you gain through the game
Extras and Gallery to collect
Available languages: English and Russian


Warnings:
Lots of alcohol
Drug use is mentioned and discussed but is not happening during the game

[From [url=https://genmitsu.itch.io/the-truth-and-faking-it]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
哥谭电视宇宙中的Gobblepot同人游戏。

奥斯瓦尔德参观了一家新酒吧，在那里他遇到了吉姆。但他当然不是来参加聚会的——这是个案。奥斯瓦尔德决定帮助他，从那时起，一切就交给你了。他们会找到罪犯吗？他们会变得更加亲密还是保持原样？去海边度假怎么样？

玩一玩就知道了！

特点：
~16000字
有点侦探的情节
调情
有点喜剧效果
结局有坏的、中立的、好的和完美的，取决于你在游戏中获得的分数
额外内容和画廊可供收集
可用语言：英语和俄语


警告：
大量酒精
游戏中提到并讨论了药物使用情况，但并未发生

[来自[url=https://genmitsu.itch.io/the-truth-and-faking-it]itch.io[/url]]
